text: Did Helen know that the bell-rope was a dummy?
why: Holmes has just found the rope is a dummy and Helen asks 'Won't it ring?', so the question arises naturally and does not point to an answer.

text: Did Helen know that the bell-rope was a dummy? — she did not know
why: Her surprised 'Won't it ring?' and her statement that the rope goes to the housekeeper's room give direct reason to consider this.

text: Did Helen know that the bell-rope was a dummy? — she knew and kept it back
id: q.helen_knew_dummy=she knew and kept it back
why: This is a plain alternative to the question, and Holmes has already caught her withholding information when she screened her stepfather; it asserts nothing as fact.
